description: Start a cross-chain swap. Returns the deposit address where you should send your source asset. API key is optional.

destinationAddress.description: Destination address on the target chain

livePriceSlippageTolerancePercent.description: Optional live price protection: how far, in percent (0 to 100, at most 2 decimals, e.g. 0.5), the execution price may fall below Chainflip's oracle price before the swap is retried and then refunded. Use a quote's recommendedLivePriceSlippageTolerancePercent. Rejected when either asset has no oracle price on Chainflip. When omitted, Chainflip's default protection for the pair applies.

minimumPrice.description: Optional minimum accepted price as a destination-per-source ratio (e.g., for a btc.btc to eth.eth swap, 28.5 means 1 BTC gets at least 28.5 ETH). When omitted, automatically calculated from current pool prices with 2% slippage tolerance. Set to 0 to accept any price.

refundAddress.description: Refund address on the source chain, used if minimum price cannot be met

name: start_swap
title: Start Swap
